# The Vault DFW

> The Vault DFW is a premium marketplace for rare and luxury collectibles — luxury watches, fine jewelry, rare coins, fine art, antiques, sports memorabilia, and precious stones. Every item is AI-verified (ProVerify multi-expert consensus) and can carry a blockchain certificate. Sellers get expert appraisals and AI buyer discovery.

## Public Pages

- [Browse Collectibles](https://thevaultdfw.win/browse): Shop verified luxury watches, jewelry, coins, art, antiques, and memorabilia.
- [AI Appraisal — $29](https://thevaultdfw.win/appraisal): Get an AI value estimate, condition and authenticity readout, and market analysis for your item. One-time payment, instant unlock.
- [ProVerify Engine — from $49.99](https://thevaultdfw.win/proverify): Multi-expert AI authentication scoring authenticity, value, and condition 0-100 with a consensus verdict.
- [Sell Your Item — $20](https://thevaultdfw.win/sell): List collectibles with a one-time fee; AI buyer search finds interested collectors worldwide.
- [Token Gallery](https://thevaultdfw.win/token-gallery): Blockchain-certified collectibles with verifiable SPL token certificates.
- [AI Concierge](https://thevaultdfw.win/concierge): Tell the concierge what you collect and get matched with relevant listings.
- [Collector Forum](https://thevaultdfw.win/forum): Community discussion on watches, coins, art, and collectibles.

## Services Summary

- **AI Appraisal**: $29 one-time. Includes estimated value with low-high range, condition and authenticity readout, market analysis with comparable bands, and factors affecting value. AI-generated estimate — not a certified appraisal.
- **ProVerify Engine**: $49.99 standard (7-10 days), $99.99 express (3-5 days), $199.99 rush (24-48 hours). Three domain-matched AI expert reviews grade authenticity, value, and condition, then a consensus verdict is generated. Preliminary assessment only — not a substitute for in-person authentication.
- **Listing Fee**: $20 one-time per listing. No monthly charges.
- **Payments**: Credit/debit cards via Stripe, cryptocurrency (Solana, BTC, ETH) via Coinbase Commerce. The Vault does not hold funds — payments go directly between buyer and seller.
- **Shipping**: All items ship insured with signature confirmation. International shipping to select countries; customs duties are the buyer's responsibility.
- **Returns**: 14 days from delivery if the item is not as described; item must be in same condition.
